terms.metaDescription: Terms and Conditions of Use of NoteFinder.
terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Use

advertising.title: Advertising and sponsored content
advertising.body: The site may show advertising and sponsored content in these ways:

items.externalAds: Ads from external tools, such as Google Ads.
items.internalAds: Our own ads, or sponsored content from people or companies that want to sponsor the site. Sponsored rows on the home page are marked as sponsored.
items.sponsorship: If you want to sponsor the site, send an email to <email>{address}</email>.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing and using NoteFinder, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions of use. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you must not use our service.

service.title: Description of the Service
service.body: NoteFinder is a platform that helps users discover the vocal notes of songs. Our service provides music analysis and note visualization tools for educational and entertainment purposes. The source code is open source, released under the MIT License, and is available at <repository>{repositoryUrl}</repository>. The license covers only the source code; it grants no rights over the music or other third-party content shown on the site.

copyright.title: Music Content and Copyright
copyright.body: Music playback on NoteFinder follows the policy below:

items.directPlayback: Direct playback on the site only when: (i) the musical work allows playback or streaming under the applicable licenses; or (ii) NoteFinder has validly acquired or licensed the rights needed to play the work internally on our domain.
items.otherCases: All other cases: the song is played exclusively through the official YouTube player, via the official YouTube API. In these cases, the content is served and controlled by YouTube, and any copyright matters are governed by YouTube's Terms of Service and policies.
items.noModification: We do not modify, redistribute or resell music content; all copyrights and related rights remain with their respective holders.
items.noStorage: We do not upload or store recordings on our servers, except where covered by a valid license that authorizes us to play them internally as described above.
items.analysisTool: NoteFinder is a tool for analyzing and visualizing music data and complies with applicable copyright law.

copyright.artistRemoval: If you are an artist whose music is on NoteFinder and you do not want it to be available here, just contact us at <email>{address}</email>.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: By using NoteFinder, you agree to:

items.lawfulUse: Use the service only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms
items.noIntrusion: Not attempt to access restricted areas of the system or reverse engineer it
items.noOverload: Not use the service in a way that could damage, disable or overload our infrastructure
items.noDataCollection: Not collect or store other users' personal data without consent
items.respectRights: Respect the copyrights and intellectual property of third parties
items.noCommercialWorks: Not use the service to create commercial derivative works without authorization

accounts.title: User Accounts
accounts.body: You are responsible for keeping your account and password confidential. You agree to accept responsibility for all activity that occurs under your account. We reserve the right to terminate accounts and to remove or edit content at our sole discretion.

privacy.title: Privacy and Data Protection
privacy.body: We take your privacy seriously. We collect and process personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the LGPD (Brazil's General Data Protection Law). The data we collect is used exclusively to provide and improve our services. When you create an account, we also store campaign details from your first and most recent visits, such as UTM parameters, advertising click IDs, the referrer and the landing page, to understand which campaigns bring new users. This information is stored in your account; we do not use a cookie for this purpose.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: NoteFinder is provided “as is” and “as available”. We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, secure or error-free. In no event will we be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages resulting from the use of, or inability to use, our service.

accuracy.title: Accuracy of Information
accuracy.body: Although we strive to provide accurate music analysis, we do not guarantee the complete accuracy of the detected notes. The analyses are based on automated algorithms and should be used as an educational reference. We are not responsible for specific interpretations or uses of the information provided.

serviceChanges.title: Changes to the Service
serviceChanges.body: We reserve the right to modify or discontinue, temporarily or permanently, the service (or any part of it) with or without prior notice. We will not be liable to you or to any third party for any modification, suspension or discontinuation of the service.

termsChanges.title: Changes to the Terms
termsChanges.body: We may revise these Terms of Use at any time without prior notice. By using this site, you agree to be bound by the current version of these Terms of Use. We recommend that you review this page periodically to be aware of any changes.

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Links
thirdParties.body: Our service may contain links to third-party websites, including YouTube. We have no control over the content, privacy policies or practices of those sites and assume no responsibility for them. We recommend that you read the terms and privacy policies of any third-party site you visit.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
governingLaw.body: These Terms will be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Brazil, without regard to its conflict of law provisions. Any dispute related to these Terms will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Brazilian courts.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have any questions about these Terms and Conditions, contact us by email at <email>{address}</email>.

general.title: General Provisions
general.body: If any provision of these Terms is held to be invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions will continue in full force and effect. Failure to exercise or enforce any right or provision of these Terms will not constitute a waiver of that right or provision.
